page.layout: One page of text: centred title block at top, a woodcut engraving (tree with banner and figure) in the middle, imprint at the foot. Handwritten marks are excluded.

main_text.l: Med. Doct. & Philosophiæ, in inclytâ Batavorum

l.i: Ad diem 24 Novemb. loco horisque solitis, postmer.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title and the imprint: a tree with spreading foliage, a serpent coiled around the trunk, a banner in the tree reading "NON SOLUS", and a standing figure at the right. Below it, a ground line with small plants. Not transcribed as text. The date is printed as cIↄ lↄc LXVI (MDCLXVI), read as MDCLXVI. The rule above the date is a printer's line. Handwritten marks at the top right ("29", "(2)") and bottom ("31") are not printed and are left out. Show-through from the reverse side is left out.
